But I appeared on a special broadcast and made my debut.
So I'm sure this place will be lined with them very soon.

Why is that? I don't know.
Yet I stood there on and on, as if listening to the sound of the waves.

Once they show me, bam! Machan's loveliness will
grab the hearts of everyone in the stands and watching at home.

Suddenly stepping closer, Aston Machan stared at the empty sachet
held in my hand. Then, poking it with the tip of her finger—
Please give that sachet to Machan.

They're different, aren't they? Being remembered, and being recalled.
They sound alike, but they're completely different.

Trainer-san? It's about time to head back.
What in the world are you looking—

With a puzzled yet somewhat excited look on her face,
Aston Machan tilted her head as she stared at the sachet.

Hmm~? A hasty Trainer-san, how unusual~.
...Hmm.

I had crafted a small sachet with colors and a design inspired by Aston Machan.
Though nothing was inside it yet.

After doing that a few times, she turned around
and peered intently into my eyes. And then—

—Honestly, making merchandise itself wouldn't be difficult.
But to have it displayed on these shelves...
Trainer-san's lens always turns the color of the sky, doesn't it?

I became her Trainer to make Aston Machan's dream come true.
If it's for that, I'll cling to even the faintest glimmer of hope.

In a situation like that, forgetting would be impossible.
Recalling the memories accumulating day by day, and thinking about the future—

I explained that it wasn't anything grand like official Aston Machan merch,
just a good-luck charm for my own satisfaction.
...Hmm-mm??
Hmm, looks like there aren't any yet.
Something that doesn't stop. Continuity, repetition. Over and over, like waves.

It feels sort of... tickly.
Tickly and itchy. But it doesn't feel bad.

Curious. I don't see any.
Or are the new products somewhere else?

To outsiders, it might be dismissed as "just merchandise" or "an exaggeration."
Yet the root behind that wish runs so remarkably deep—

It's okay, it's okay. I'll get lots stronger and do great.
Then lots of people will have Machan in their eyes.

It's fine. Being the very first one makes it special.
...Ah, but it really does feel tickly.

Picking out fabric, choosing thread, perched in the crafting corner.
Asking the shop staff all sorts of questions... You were a little nervous, weren't you?
Yes, I'm looking forward to it. Full of excitement.

Thinking some kind of merch might be out by now,
I came to check the Umamusume goods section with Aston Machan, but...

A good-luck charm? ...So you won't forget Machan?
Would you forget about Machan if you didn't have that?
How strange. What could it be? Tickly... Hmm-mm?

Waving to the blank-faced Aston Machan,
I quickened my pace toward "that" which had caught my eye.
Saying so, she turned around and walked away.

...The sachet has Machan's colors.
It looks like Machan.
...Is that so?

Wondering if this was really good enough, I held up the sachet and stared at it again.
...It really was a bit misshapen. When I asked if I should remake it—
Oh, that simply won't do~. Whatever shall we do?

Trainer, you remember me,
and you keep remembering me over and over again.

Looking at it just makes me feel all the more fidgety.
I wonder why~?

Her words and presence carry an airy, gentle softness,
yet her feelings are earnestly and overwhelmingly strong.

Yes. Trainer had such a serious look, stitch by stitch, needle by needle.
Before I knew it, Machan had been watching the whole time.
...Is that, Machan's dream?
It's almost as if Trainer created a brand new Machan.

With an aura that leaves it unclear whether she is joking or serious,
Aston Machan gazes over at me.
Remembering, thinking, recalling.

Hmm~. To the right, to the left, all the way in the back~.
Where could the Machan merch be~?
Even while remembering, recalling again and again...

But I've appeared on a special TV broadcast, and I've made my debut too.
I'm sure that very soon, shelves here will be lined with them~.

So this is like a wish. It's too misshapen to truly be called merchandise,
and it's just one tiny sachet, but even so—
I hand the sachet to Aston Machan.

...I was peeking over, wondering where you were headed.
And then, you slipped right into a craft store.

Watching Aston Machan tilt her head,
I find myself tilting my head in turn.

Never letting her be forgotten. Ensuring she is remembered forever.
I want to make that wish come true no matter what.

Machan wants that.
May I have it?

Of course. Not just every day, but multiple times a day I think about it.
About training, and about Aston Machan's dream.
What is truly sad is being forgotten.

"Why not try making a handmade sachet together?"
A poster at a craft store caught my eye.
